messages.text: ok so i just finished the zoom transition. it’s kinda smooth?? but when i tested the full flow starting from the atlas, it felt like a maze 🤯
that's the point. start on one person's explanation. then zoom out. if you start with the graph they lose the thread before we explain why it matters.
wait, so no grand entrance? just 'hey look at these two people'? feels anti-climactic 😂
it's not anti-climactic, it's focused. judges need to understand the connection logic first. the atlas is the context, not the hook.
fair. i can do that. but can we add a little 'sparkle' when they connect? just for vibes ✨
no sparkles. we're not doing a casino slot machine. keep it clean. turquoise only.
ok fine. but i'm adding a subtle glow to the text. that's not a sparkle, it's typography.
as long as it doesn't animate. static glow is fine. moving glow is a no.
deal. so we freeze code on thursday? like, actually freeze? no 'one more tiny fix' after 6pm?
thursday 6pm. hard stop. anything not merged by then is gone. we need the weekend to test, not code.
ugh but what if the search bar alignment is off on mobile? that's a tiny fix right?
if it's not broken, don't touch it. if it is broken, we fix it before thursday. after thursday, it stays.
you're so strict 😤 but ok. i'll check the mobile viewport tonight.
do that. and also make sure the canvas pauses when the tab is hidden. battery life matters for the demo.
already did that! remember? visibilitychange listener. i'm good at this stuff 🙃
good. go test the flow. start with the explanation, end with the atlas. time it. should be under 3 mins.
